note: Exact visual identity, not merely a similar caption: same keeper-house sash/door arrangement, adjoining log gable and upright barred-looking light, stockade gate, oxen, paired dogs, foreground standing figures, crowds, tents and both flocks of birds. UCR / 1947surrogates crop this full 1902composition. No formal pixelmetric is claimed. The depiction is a retrospective illustration published 66 years after its 1836caption date. Gale p51 calls the jail small, concealed within a high plank palisade, and identifies John Beach’s house as partly within the enclosure and facing Randolph. It does not specify a core eave height, pitch, opening dimensions or exact addition sequence. The 1836caption remains 1836; adjacent 1835recollection is not converted into exact proof that every pictured detail existed by 1 July 1835. Andreas’s distinct 1884plate depicts a contrasting shallow hip/pyramidal rear cap, and its prose distinguishes original jail/later separate oaken cell without an alteration date.
